name: demo-selenium-typescript-for-google-maps
summary: A beginner-friendly, TypeScript, real-assertion demo describing Selenium WebDriver browser automation against the live Google Maps website.
description: Describes driving a real Chrome browser to https://www.google.com/maps, checking the home page title contains 'Google Maps', searching for 'Cardiff Castle' and checking the resulting URL contains 'Cardiff', then clicking 'Zoom in' and checking the zoom level encoded in the URL (@lat,lng,zoomz) increased. Written and reviewed for correctness but deliberately never executed against the live site by this repo's own tooling, because Google's Terms of Service restrict automated querying of Google Maps.
